title: Shining Statue of Mine
author: Til Kumari Sharma
text:
Shining as moon and her lone journey
Delight in loneliness and tears
Not like the crowd
So I make my statue myself
The determination of life itself
The life of struggle
Light in ladder by myself
Myself guide and heart of kindness
Giving light to others in darkness
The shining bond of light
The words carve my statue
The hands type my words
Creating the strong statue
Never fallen behind
My journey of loneliness
Like alienated moon herself.
Shining in universe as art of words
Dignified by light of words
Making figure of my ethics
Life in darkness seeks brightness
Alone I am able to light myself.
Morning of words in light
Hiding behind the dark side
Making statue of my art
Giving priority to my insanity of ideas
Ethical garland of words
Around statue of myself, to the light of earth
Being goddess of universe.
Untouched by people, unused by fake
Words make the statue of myself.
